title.zh: 宣布每年 8 月 30 日为 Sinacaban 市镇特别非工作公共假日，名称为 Araw Ng Sinacaban 的法案
title.en: An Act to Declare the Thirtieth Day of August of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of Sinacaban to Be Known as Araw Ng Sinacaban
title.orig: An Act to Declare the Thirtieth Day of August of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of Sinacaban to Be Known as Araw Ng Sinacaban

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8409_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Thirtieth day of August of every year is hereby declared as a special nonworking public holiday in the Municipality of Sinacaban, Province of Misamis Occidental.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
